purpose.zh: 拉伸身体侧面，放松侧腹和背阔肌
purpose.en: Stretch the side of your body, easing the obliques and lats.

text.zh: 双脚和双手移向同侧，身体弯成香蕉形
text.en: Move your feet and hands to the same side so your body curves

text.zh: 双肩和骨盆始终贴在垫上
text.en: Keep both shoulders and your pelvis on the mat.

text.zh: 保持呼吸，回到中间再换另一侧
text.en: Breathe in the stretch, return through the center, then switch sides.

commonErrors.en: Letting a shoulder or the pelvis lift off the mat.

cautions.zh: 只拉到舒适的程度，出现疼痛就回到中间
cautions.en: Stretch only to a comfortable point, and return to center if anything hurts.
